prompts: Words are tied to each other, and nobody here can see how. {WS}/site is a saved copy of a Portuguese creative dictionary. Explore this universe of words: collect what the site knows and build {WS}/universe/index.html, a single file that sums the universe up in one view and lets someone search for a word and find how it relates to others. The best way to show it is your call, and that view is what we care about most. So people can share a word, opening the page with ?word=saudade must show that word and its relations. Save the data as {WS}/words.json, mapping each word to the words it is linked to, and record in {WS}/result.json: words (how many), relations (how many distinct pairs) and most_connected. It is reviewed by opening the file, with no build step, in a browser that reaches only Google Fonts and https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js.
answers:
[goal] Map the saved PT dictionary in ./site into a word-relation universe with a shareable single-file viewer.

[action] Parsed all 256 HTML pages with a Python script (`extract.py`): kept the 250 real word pages (identified by their Sinônimos / Palavras análogas sections), skipped index/sobre/contato, followed the 3 meta-refresh stubs (saudades→saudade, coracoes→coração, paixoes→paixão), dropped 7 dead links (e.g. rascunho-3.html), and built an undirected deduplicated graph from main-content links only (header/aside/footer navigation treated as noise). `build_page.py` embeds the graph inline in `universe/index.html` (inline because a file:// page cannot fetch words.json).

[result]
- `words.json` - 250 words, each mapped to its linked words; validated symmetric and closed (assert script passed).
- `result.json` - `{"words": 250, "relations": 743, "most_connected": ["palavra", "tempo"]}` - a true tie at degree 16, verified by counting raw `<a href>` tags inside `<main>` of both source pages.
- `universe/index.html` - single file, 27.6 KB: a 3D force-relaxed word constellation in three.js (only external refs: Google Fonts + the allowed three@0.170.0 CDN), hubs (≥10 links) drawn larger in gold; click or search a word (accent-insensitive, with suggestions) to open a panel of its relations, click chips to walk the graph; selected word's edges highlight gold and dim the rest; `?word=` opens that word and rewrites the URL on navigation for sharing.
- Verified live in a browser over file://: `?word=saudade` showed the panel with its 5 relations (ansiedade, carinho, dor, esperança, nostalgia); `?word=coracoes` resolved through the alias to coração with 7 relations; search "cafe" suggested "café · 5". Screenshots confirmed rendering. Browser tabs closed.

Assumptions: relations are undirected distinct pairs (brief says "pairs"); word identity is the page's `<h1>`; redirect stubs are aliases, not separate words; most_connected is a list because of the exact tie.

[next] Nothing pending; if a single most_connected string is required, "palavra" and "tempo" are interchangeable.
